title: AntigravityTaskReport
description: Standardized schema for Antigravity Agent task reports in Personal Finance Super App

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the report schema (e.g. 1.0.0)

task_id.description: Unique identifier for the task or sub-phase (e.g. phase-2i-nav-fix)

phase.description: Human-readable phase title (e.g. Phase 2I — Navigation Functional Fix)

task_status.description: Final execution status of the task

summary.description: Concise summary of actions taken and architectural decisions made

changed_files.description: List of relative file paths created, modified, or inspected

exit_code.description: Process exit code (0 for success, non-zero for failure)

stdout_summary.description: Optional brief summary of command output without leaking secrets

commands_run.description: List of terminal verification commands run during the task

build_result.description: Outcome of project build verification (e.g. npm run build)

test_results.description: Summary of type checking, linting, or automated test executions

errors.description: List of errors, exceptions, or failures encountered during the task

risks.description: Known risks, edge cases, or regression warnings

next_recommended_action.description: Specific recommended next phase or prompt to execute

project_progress_percent.description: Provisional weighted milestone progress percentage between 0 and 100

verification_type.description: Classification of evidence backing the report findings

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the report was finalized
